quantile_grid.definition: inverted-CDF empirical quantile of valid core cells

kernels.relative_elevation: z - median(z) over the valid core

exclusion.rule: Analysis cell excluded when at least half of its area is WorldCover built-up (class 50); no buffer
exclusion.note: Assessed after the first measurement; re-measuring with the mask reproduced every quantile exactly (no built-up cells).

dem_nasadem.product: NASADEM_HGT v001 (reprocessed SRTM; shared lineage with SRTMGL1)

dem_cop-dem-glo-30.product: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (TanDEM-X; independent lineage, surface model)
